newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RBNZ sees sustainable growth of 2.75 pct.
newsitem.headline: RBNZ sees sustainable growth of 2.75 pct.

text.p: The Reserve Bank on Friday said it assumed a potential growth rate for the economy of 2.75 percent a year.

In its projections released on Thursday the Treasury put sustainable growth at 3.5 percent, but Reserve Bank Governor Don Brash said "no one was dogmatic about the potential growth rate" and there was a wide range of estimates.
The RBNZ said it expected growth in trend labour productivity would strengthen. "However..even abstracting from cyclical factors, recent labour productivity outturns have not shown this strength."
